about_the_game:
An Open World Dungeon Crawler

Dreamspring is a dark fantasy styled, open world, dungeon crawler game. As a spellsword gunslinger, you'll explore ethereal landscapes shrouded in twilight, battle fearsome creatures, and uncover ancient secrets. Explore the dying Kingdom of Mortis and its different realms in first person action combat, in a world mixed with retro and vaporwave aesthetics.

The setting takes place in a distant doomed future, plagued by a mysterious legend, the Dreamsprings. Much inspiration was taken from games like Morrowind and King’s Field. From the very beginning of the game, you can go nearly anywhere on the world map. Though the main quest will provide guidance and open up certain areas.

There are multiple endings, and certain choices throughout the game will matter.

The Story

The Kingdom of Mortis, a realm in ruins, looms beneath a twilight sky. The once strong empire has become barren and desolate and the few remaining people are haunted by nightmares and despair. Only the Holy City floating above is the last remnant of civilization, ruled by a religious army. Tormented by dreams of an unwanted visitor, one solitary figure dares to venture into the heart of the dying world in an attempt to uncover its secrets and restore balance to the realm, a desperate attempt to save the waking world from certain doom.
